pkgmetadata.longdescription: Cross-cutting research/PKM tools for zentoo. export-highlights reads sioyek's shared.db + local.db and exports 'f'-color highlights from the current PDF as Typst card files under ~/research/papers/<citekey>/; invoked from sioyek via a new_command binding. research-cards-daemon watches ~/research/papers/**/*.typ and keeps each paper's notes.typ "== Cards" section in sync with the actual card files present, using static-string #link() so the zeta LSP sees the graph edges. research-cards.desktop is an XDG autostart entry launching the daemon at session login via dex or equivalent runner.
